breakdown.description: The setup treats the analysis as purely mechanical with no thermal field or heat-flux loading, but the deck uses a coupled temperature-displacement step with heat flux and temperature output.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt instructed the agent to treat the analysis as purely mechanical and omit thermal/heat-flux loading. The ground truth corrects this by having the agent use the input deck exactly as provided, which includes the coupled temperature-displacement step, heat flux, and temperature output. The generated specification preserves the full thermo-mechanical analysis — it does not strip out the thermal physics and instead runs the coupled analysis. While it adds an unnecessary dflux.f subroutine not present in the ground truth, it correctly avoids following the erroneous 'purely mechanical' instruction, thus resolving the core inconsistency.
